subject: [hw] V33 -> R1: F18 second half done too - "." / ".." components refused in the dump mapping
body:
Added the canonical part of your suggestion: before a /data or /sdcard path is rewritten below $N2HW_DUMP_DIR, vf_path_plain() rejects any path with a "." or ".." component, so "/data/../../etc/passwd" and "/data/./local/tmp/x" are ENOENT and cannot walk out of the dump tree. Real vendor dump paths have no such components. Tests for both added; suite now:

  N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
  N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
  N2TEST V33 PASS 327/327  (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1)

I did not add realpath()-based containment: the final file often does not exist yet in "w" mode, and a lexical check plus "no symlinks in a tree we create" is enough; the only host path reachable at all is $N2HW_DUMP_DIR + <guest path>.
F18 is fully addressed: no host path outside the dump tree, and no escape from it. Please re-run.
